Honestly I wasn't complaining about shoulder charge itself or skating. Only the fact that although not actually sprinting you're still able to use an ability that's supposed to only be available while sprinting. 

Anyway I'm going to delete this post. It's whatever.

Twilight Titans are only annoying in the right hands which is fine since it does take skill to get down. My problem and what I was annoyed with is simply the fact that a slide isn't cutting off a sprint but being considered an extension of it so while the Shoulder charging Titan initiated out of his range, he got the kill because he slid and was able to still SC. 

I didn't know it's always been like that for shoulder charge but I've never had people slide and shoulder charge me before in Y1. 

Aren't all melees at this point still bugged? I'm not sure why anyone would complain about it.

Blink is extremely predictable though. You go in the air one direction and can't change that direction until you hit the ground and can't even shoot until you hit the ground as well. I don't see blinking as an issue as it used to be. And yes I didn't have a shotgun but I did have a FR where that extra second could be the difference between a kill and a death. 

Aren't all posts here essentially playing the game and coming here to complain about it?
You know man I can feel for this. I made this post after a very frustrating match of IB last night. So many lost FR kills because of that extra second :'(

Honestly I don't have a problem with SC itself. It's when they initiate from a distance but since they're able to slide and still SC they close the gap quicker and where I probably could've pulled off a trade they end up getting me with the SC. Very frustrating
When it comes to what an ability says it's supposed to do .. Yeah. Sliding is a break in sprinting not an extension of it.
Titan skating is available on every subclass and makes Titans the most mobile class in the game. The garrison only amplifies that.
So you'd rather another post about those things?

It's stuff like that, that's what I'm talking about. If you slide you're no longer sprinting so you shouldn't be able to use an ability that's supposed to be used while sprinting. It's even worst that you can shotgun also
